text:
Alex Chen: hey folks :wave: I'm Alex on infra. Need Vault + KMS access for onboarding (dev DB creds, test stripe). Who do I ping and what's the minimal request flow? Also what's our rotation policy so I don't request permanent creds?

Maria Gonzales: welcome! :tada: quick path: 1) onboarding secrets form https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets (team=infra) 2) Okta group `secrets-readers` (DevEx can add after form) 3) open eng-security ticket for write/KMS/unseal role requests 4) prefer short-lived leases for dev work

Tom Nguyen: <@Alex Chen> security notes: read-only paths are OK via the form. write/unseal/KMS require manager approval + eng-security review. Rotation defaults: service secrets rotate every 90d; dev CLI leases are 1h-24h. Request longer TTL only with justification.

Maria Gonzales: dev tips: after approval DevEx Bot will DM steps. To read a secret locally: `vault kv get -field=password secret/team/infra/dev-db`. KMS operations require GCP IAM binding; file a ticket for crypto roles.

DevEx Bot: Hi Alex — placeholder workflow created. Steps: 1) submit form 2) attach manager approval 3) wait for eng-security (~1 business day). Links: https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/onboarding and https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/rotation

Alex Chen: cool — submitted form and opened ticket SEC-4521 with manager approval. Requested dev-sandbox creds (4h TTL) first. I'll update once approved.

Maria Gonzales: nice. For faster review add "onboarding: Alex Chen" in the ticket title and ping Tom.

Tom Nguyen: noted. If you need prod access later we'll do a separate review and rotation schedule.
